gomad: drive the adapter test template from one table and drop housekeeping architecture checks

The seven rewritten-module adapters share one consumer, identity,
drift, comment, and unrewritten-inventory template driven by
rewrittenModuleAdapters; configuration-drift, host-dispatch, and
pinned-inventory tests become tables. architecture_test.go keeps its
import and export rules and drops 11 deleted-file, banned-word, and
required-filename checks, each with a reason in the retained mapping.
Coverage of deterministicio is unchanged; the CLI and Runner parts are
deferred until fn-109 lands, with their mapping prepared.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

gomad: consolidate the CLI and Runner change-detector tests into tables

The CLI forwarded-field and outcome tests become one table per command
on the merged fakeInstallation seam, comparing whole forwarded requests.
Runner preparation partials, resume rejections, coordinator responses
(one canned coordinator helper), replay preflight, and cancellation
become tables; the supervision-rejected unterminated trace joins the
completion characterization for every strategy, and validation tests
whose full error text the golden campaign options table pins are
removed, with the one missing rejection added as a golden row. The
error text pinned twice in completion_test.go is kept once. The task 9
mapping now covers cli and runner, with each validation mapping checked
against the golden error.

reviewed_comments: // TestRunAnalyzeForwardsTargetAndClassifiesReport pins the target an analyze
// request reviews and the status each review, report, cleanup and output
// result maps to. Each row starts from dependencies that review the target
// and report it unsupported.
// configure replaces dependencies; closures it installs report through
// the row's t.
// wantStderr is a substring of stderr; empty requires empty stderr.
// anyStderr leaves stderr unchecked.
// Unsupported, invalid and infrastructure statuses.
// qualifyObservation is what one qualify request hands its dependencies: the
// toolchain roots it resolved, every Campaign and replay request, and the
// report it retained, if any. Every request that runs a Campaign retains a
// report.
// TestRunQualifyForwardsFlagsAndClassifiesOutcome pins, for each qualify
// request, the Campaign and replay requests it forwards, the report it
// retains, and the status and result event it reports.
// run and replay answer the call-th request, counted from 1. A nil
// function fails the test when the command calls it.
// Successful replay needs both the request and explicit bounds.
// TestRunResumeForwardsCampaignAndClassifiesResult pins the resume request
// built from the stored Campaign and the installation, and how its result and
// errors are reported.
// TestRunMinimizeForwardsFlags pins the minimization request each flag set
// forwards with the resolved installation, and the summary it reports.
// Minimization resumes only on request.
// TestRunQualifySetForwardsFlags pins the qualification set request each
// accepted flag set forwards with the current executable, and the shard
// checks that reject a request before the set runs.
// want is the forwarded request, or nil when the set must not run.
// pinnedReleaseGo returns a go command of the pinned release, whose release
// tags select prepared package files exactly as the target build does.
// TestAdapterPreparedSourceSetPinsReproduceOnEveryHost recomputes every
// adapter's prepared source-set pin for every platform it is pinned for from
// the prepared replacement's sources, so a host of any platform derives the
// pins the qualified platforms' capability reviews check.
// newRegenerationFixture copies the pinned module of adapter as both the
// previous and the candidate version; change edits the candidate.
// Appending a comment changes the file but not which files each platform
// compiles, so the source set changes on both platforms the same way.
// TestAdapterSourceEditsReplaceEveryAnchor regenerates memberlist, whose
// version v0.5.4 is also go-metrics' version, and checks that only the
// memberlist literals change.
// A test literal naming the module version, such as a go.mod replace
// directive, moves to the proposed version with the adapter.
// rewrittenModuleAdapters lists the adapters built on prepareRewrittenModule
// with the package whose prepared source set each one pins.
// outsideServerGraph marks an adapter for a module the server does not
// depend on; its prepared source set is reviewed through a fixture module.
// The fields below drive the shared adapter test template; an adapter
// without cacheDir is covered only by the tests above the template.
// cacheDir is the module's escaped module-cache directory without its
// version, unrewritten a module file no rewrite touches, and
// ambiguousAnchor a text that occurs more than once in every rewritten
// file. otherModule and otherVersion are changed identities the adapter
// must reject.
// rewriteDropsComments marks an adapter whose rewrite removes code
// together with its comments, so original comments are not kept.
// consumer is the stock consumer fixture under testdata/<name>.
// The MemFS implementation is the unrewritten file, so preparation
// must copy it unchanged.
// Its consumer, TestHashicorpMetricsAdapterConsumer, goes through the
// default registry and capability review instead of the template.
// TestRewrittenModulesRejectChangedIdentity requires every adapter to reject
// a changed sum and, where the template names them, a changed module path and
// version, before it reads the module cache.
// TestRewrittenModulePreparedPackageSourceSetIdentity reviews each prepared
// package through the server module's dependency graph, so the recorded
// source-set pins are the ones a Temporal target observes.
// TestRewrittenModuleOutsideServerGraphPreparedSourceSetIdentity reviews the
// adapters for modules the server does not depend on through a fixture module
// that does, so their prepared source-set pins match what such a target sees.
// PrepareTargetBuildAdapters downloads the pinned module, which the
// server's own module cache does not hold.
// downloadPinnedModule fetches an adapter module the server does not depend on
// into the pinned toolchain's module cache, from outside every module so no
// go.sum is rewritten.
// TestProfileRejectsAdapterConfigurationDrift requires the default profile to
// refuse a target whose go.mod or go.sum the adapter for its module cannot
// replace exactly.
// TestRewrittenModuleRewritesPreserveCommentsAndRejectDrift checks each
// rewritten file of every template adapter: the rewrite keeps every original
// comment, and a changed upstream file, a missing or ambiguous anchor, or a
// replacement that does not match its digest is rejected.
// TestRewrittenModulesRejectUnrewrittenInventoryDrift changes a module file
// that no rewrite touches; the module's source inventory must reject it.
// adapterConsumer runs an adapter's stock consumer fixture, testdata/<name>
// with <name>_test.go, against the prepared build modfile.
// testFlags go between "go test -v" and the modfile flags; listFlags
// between "go list" and the modfile flags.
// prepared runs once after the fixture's tests pass.
// platform runs for each platform after its prepared source set matches.
// consumerRun runs the go command in dir and fails the test on error.
// consumerPackage is the go list -json view of the prepared package.
// TestRewrittenModuleConsumers prepares each adapter for its stock consumer
// fixture, runs the fixture's tests through the prepared build modfile, and
// requires the prepared package's source set on darwin/arm64 and linux/amd64
// to equal that platform's pin.
// sentryReplacementPassesUpstreamBuildInfoTests runs the upstream build-info
// tests inside the prepared Sentry replacement.
// sentryConsumerHasNoSubprocessImports requires the prepared Sentry package to
// reach neither os/exec nor golang.org/x/sys/execabs on the platform.
// pebbleConsumerLinksNoNativeVFS links the Pebble consumer's test binary for
// the platform and requires that no OS-backed VFS wrapper method is linked.
// TestPinnedAdapterModuleInventories digests each adapted module in the
// pinned toolchain's module cache against its reviewed source inventory.
// TestManifestInterceptsBeforeHostDispatch requires each listed operation to be
// in the interception manifest with its hook, and the hook to consult the
// profile before it can reach the host implementation.
// guarded reports whether the start of a hook's body keeps it
// from its host implementation.
// The original fixture pins selections, environments, errors and plan records.
// Its flat coordinator projection normalizes the omitted seed strategy.
// legacyCharacterizationChildTimeout stands in for the child deadline that the
// isolated parent derives from its own remaining time.
// legacyCharacterizationCoordinator is a coordinator command that cannot start, so
// an isolated Explore that passes every request check stops at the process
// boundary with a stable error.
// dependencies are the private substitutions the request runs with.
// frozenGuidance attaches the frozen guidance a resumed or sharded
// campaign restores from its recorded plan.
// explore also runs Explore through the isolated path, whose request
// checks precede and follow campaign validation.
// exploreLocal also runs Explore through the local path.
// pinBytes keeps the complete request bytes in the table, not only their
// digest, so a representative request of each shape stays readable.
// legacyCharacterizationError removes the only host-dependent text an error can
// carry, the working directory a relative resume path resolves against.
// Accepted requests for each strategy and campaign shape.
// Isolated request checks around campaign validation.
// Resume rejections.
// Selection and sharding rejections.
// Strategy bound rejections.
// Execution limit rejections.
// Observation rejections.
// Retention rejections.
// Guidance rejections.
// Failure policy rejections.
// Process wiring and target environment rejections.
// Simultaneous faults pin which check wins.
// legacyCharacterizeValidation, legacyCharacterizeCoordinatorRequest and the exploreWith
// calls, which carry a case's private substitutions, are the only parts of
// this test that name the implementation under characterization.
// legacyCharacterizationPrepared is a fixed prepared target, so a campaign plan
// record depends only on the campaign request it maps.
// legacyCharacterizationPlan clears the plan members that identify this Runner's
// implementation rather than the campaign request: they legitimately change
// with a rebuilt toolchain or the development platform.
// legacyCharacterizeCoordinatorRequest returns the request bytes the isolated
// parent sends and its projection with the documented strategy default.
// completionObservation is what one campaign leaves observable after its
// executions completed: the host failure, the counters (attempted, succeeded,
// failures, watchdogs, distinct failures), every published failure artifact,
// every journaled execution and every partial that outlived the campaign.
// faultExecutor completes every execution of its strategy's well-formed
// executor with one fixed fault applied to the captured result.
// Each row fixes one captured result and pins what every strategy makes of it.
// The exploration strategies share one expectation: they fail the whole round
// before committing it, so only the cancellation diagnostic names the strategy.
// The digest and record count are consistent, so supervision accepts the
// trace and only the coverage projection decodes the payload.
// A context cancelled while executions run fails the Campaign as a
// cancellation. A seed Campaign leaves a resumable plan and its partials; an
// exploration round fails ahead of the cancelled results its candidates then
// report.
// The round returns while its candidate is still exiting, so the
// candidate's partial state is not settled yet.
// A well-formed completion carries its World record, semantic probe and choice
// features into the execution evidence and the journal for fixed identities.
// TestCompletionFaultsKeepReasonPrecedenceAndEvidence pins the malformed
// record and seed mismatch errors through every strategy.
// reason is the host failure reason; the error text of each reason is
// pinned by TestCompletionFaultsKeepReasonPrecedenceAndEvidence.
// TestReplayDoesNotStartTarget pins the replays that end before the target
// starts: verification-only replay of an intact artifact succeeds, and replay
// of an artifact whose compatibility packs, payload or shared target no longer
// verify fails.
// publish returns the artifact path and the result a started target
// would report.
// wantVerified expects verification to succeed; otherwise replay fails.
// TargetPool publishes the artifact into a store that shares its target.
// The runnable decision has one alternative to expand; the select's does
// not, in the root's round or in the resumed one.
// TestRunResumeRejectsChangedEvidence pins that resuming an interrupted
// Campaign fails when the evidence it recorded no longer matches.
// interrupt starts the Campaign and returns once it is interrupted.
// change alters the interrupted Campaign or the resume request.
// TestRunPreparationFailureLeavesClassifiedPartial pins the reason a target
// preparation failure, cancellation or overall timeout reports, and the
// explicit preparation partial each one leaves.
// start returns the preparer and the context the Campaign runs with.
// TestIsolatedRunnerPreservesCoordinatorResponse pins what the isolated parent
// makes of each canned coordinator response: typed preparation and coverage
// errors, bounded evidence, the transported choice trace configuration, and
// the bound on coordinator output.
// cannedCoordinatorConfig runs the isolated parent against
// TestCannedCoordinatorHelper answering with response.
// TestCannedCoordinatorHelper is a coordinator subprocess that answers with
// the canned response GOMAD3_CANNED_COORDINATOR names.
// alternatives is the width of the one decision every execution records;
// zero means two.
// noOpSelect adds a two-case select with one ready case after that
// decision, whose poll order the explorer must leave unexpanded.
// scenarios is the width of the one scenario decision every execution
// records; zero means two.
// The decisions precede the only observation, so a forced decision's
// ordinal is its record's.
// forceTestChoiceRank selects the alternative at rank of a decision record
// built by validTestChoiceRecord, whose alternative set is ordered by identity.
// A target the watchdog kills never writes its terminal choice frame; the run
// is the watchdog outcome, retained without a choice profile, not an
// unterminated-trace runner failure that discards the evidence.
// retainedTargets returns every file under root that holds the content, and
// how many of them are artifact targets.
// distinctFiles counts the files the paths name, counting hard links to one
// file once.
// Three successes per succeeding campaign, three distinct failures per
// failing seed and choice campaign, and the one failure identity the
// simulation candidates share.
// sharedTargetReplayer records every replayed artifact whose target is not a
// link to the pool of its store's owner: the minimizer's work directory for a
// candidate, the output root for the published artifact.
